storage_metrics.snapshot_tag_count: unique retained Tag UIDs, including initial COMMITTED recovery points
storage_metrics.snapshot_write_bytes: measured physical trial writes; logical upload samples remain in separate storage evidence

acceptance.rule: all frozen seed pairs and requests complete; finite resource measurements with >=90% coverage; both paired difference upper bounds <=0 and at least one <0
acceptance.v2_protocol: same Runner within each seed and symmetric-program-v1

primary_selection: earliest attempt per concurrency, policy and seed; independent of outcome
latency_population: completed requests; failure and unoffered denominators retained separately

bootstrap.method: hierarchical seed-trial and whole-workspace percentile bootstrap; paired seed differences
bootstrap.latency_ci_unit: whole workspace trajectory within seed trial
